image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white ceramic bowl containing fresh figs and flower petals. One whole green fig with purple speckling sits at the top left. A halved fig revealing pink/amber flesh and seeds is at the bottom left. White lily-like petals are scattered on the right side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pear-shaped fruit with soft, thin skin in green, purple, or brownish coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whole fruit exhibits the characteristic green skin with purple/brownish speckling typical of ripe figs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth to slightly wrinkled texture with matte finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin appears smooth with a natural matte sheen, consistent with real fruit texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated pear shape with tapered form from broad base to narrow stem end.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whole fig displays the correct obovoid/pear-like geometry, tapering toward the stem.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small ostiole (eye) at bottom of fruit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The small dark spot (ostiole) is clearly visible at the apex of the whole fig.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Narrow stem end contrasting with broad rounded base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The geometric proportion between the stem attachment point and the bulbous body is anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin, easily bruised skin covering soft interior.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the skin looks thin, 'easily bruised' is a tactile property not fully testable visually without damage evidence, though no unnatural rigidity is seen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cut cross-section reveals hollow interior filled with numerous tiny seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The halved fig clearly shows the internal cavity structure packed with many small, distinct seeds.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Sweet, pink to amber-colored fleshy pulp surrounding seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The cut surface displays the correct gradient of colors from outer white rind to amber/pink inner flesh.
The visual rendering of the cut flesh suggests moisture and softness, lacking the dry or plastic look of bad AI generations.

artifact_observations.location: White flower petals on the right
artifact_observations.reasoning: The petals have a slightly waxy, uniform smoothness that lacks the fine venation typically seen in lily petals, suggesting minor generative smoothing.
The elliptical curve of the bowl rim is slightly inconsistent, appearing slightly warped rather than a perfect geometric ellipse, though this could be lens distortion.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific variety and biological correctness of the external skin patterns.
To verify the internal seed distribution and pulp coloration match real fig anatomy.
To assess overall lighting consistency and detect subtle blending artifacts between the fruit and the bowl.
To check for edge bleeding or haloing against the white bowl background.

focus_areas: Internal seed structure realism in the cut fig
Skin texture micro-details on the whole fig
Boundary sharpness between fruit and bowl
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the white rind and the colored flesh in the cut fig; AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Also, verify if the 'seeds' are distinct entities or just noise patterns.
